verificationLimits: Closed-page axe checks only; no open-dialog, Firefox ESR140 or native accessibility acceptance.
Every progress value, start and completion is authored debug input; no real analysis, worker pause, cache write or playback occurs.
Layout overflow flags and rendered-pixel clearance are not glyph metrics or acceptance of the Resume label at 200% text.
Status readings are read by eye and bound by hash; only label clearance is re-measured from the embedded pixels.
Measured rectangles are checked for mutual consistency and against the crop, not re-derived from the device.
Synthetic changed-inset and changed-witness fixtures are validation controls, not extra Android captures.
Full Android lint retains five inherited errors, 65 warnings and two hints.
